_comment: FROZEN expected-outcome baseline for the L4 real-machine Kanban test. Diff the run's L4_kanban_results.json against this to get a PASS/FAIL verdict. L4 validates the Kanban executor->fixer->executor DEPENDENCY CHAIN and timing, NOT that the tests pass (the retry subset fails by design on the offline remote). Hence: dependency_chain_invariants are HARD assertions (must hold every run); terminal_state_distribution is remote-dependent (the offline env cannot download models, so download/network errors are unfixable and end as ignored after max_retry).

dependency_chain_invariants.rule: fixer does not start before executor completes Round 1
dependency_chain_invariants.check: first ut-fixer task claim timestamp > last ut-executor Round-1 complete timestamp

dependency_chain_invariants.rule: fixer only receives tests that executor marked failed/error in Round 1
dependency_chain_invariants.check: every fixer-handled node appears in Round-1 executor results with status in [failed, error]

dependency_chain_invariants.rule: single-claim: each batch/fix task is claimed by exactly one gateway
dependency_chain_invariants.check: no node has >1 concurrent executor claim; no duplicate fixer claim

dependency_chain_invariants.rule: executor re-runs only fixer-produced fixed_pending_verify nodes in Round 3 (if any)
dependency_chain_invariants.check: Round-3 executor input set == nodes set to fixed_pending_verify by fixer in Round 2

dependency_chain_invariants.rule: retriable_error nodes are re-selected only while retry_count < max_retry (3); at max they become ignored, not re-run forever
dependency_chain_invariants.check: no node executed more than max_retry+1 times; retriable_error at max_retry -> ignored

per_test.expected_trajectory: pending -> (R1 executor) error/failed -> (R2 fixer) classified unfixable-on-offline -> retriable_error -> retry until max_retry -> ignored
pending -> (R1 executor) error (model not cached) -> (R2 fixer) delegate dependency-resolver -> offline, cannot download -> retriable_error -> ignored at max_retry
pending -> (R1 executor) error (model not cached) -> (R2 fixer) delegate dependency-resolver -> offline, cannot download -> retriable_error -> ignored at max_retry

terminal_state_distribution._note: Remote-dependent (offline env). Expected for the standard offline run below. If a model happens to be pre-cached, that node may instead end 'passed' after fixer verify -- record the deviation, it is not a failure of the framework.
terminal_state_distribution.tolerance: any split across {ignored, passed} totalling 3 is acceptable; failed/pending=0 and total=3 are required

must_all_hold: fixer round occurred AFTER executor round (timing observed in gateway logs)
record_but_not_fail: wall-clock throughput vs Linear baseline (comparison metric, not pass gate)

artifacts_to_capture: remote vLLM git commit hash (recorded before run; fixer edits rolled back after)
